title: ever LUCIE|Off-Shoulder Sweetheart Double Layer Pleated Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant bridesmaid dress combines romance and sophistication with its off-shoulder sweetheart neckline and double-layered pleats. The flattering design highlights your silhouette, while the soft pleats add movement and grace. Perfect for bridesmaids who want a chic, timeless look for the big day.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

?

Length: Floor length.

?

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

?

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

?

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

?

Fabric: The garment comprises tulle.

?

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
